name: Kőszeg (Hungary)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the town arms of Kőszeg: a blue shield with a white castle with three towers, supported by two angels, above a scroll inscribed ADIUTORIUM NOSTRUM DEUS.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kőszeg arms with angel supporters and scroll
